resources.string: Connect your espresso machine to start brewing
Camera permission is missing, please grant it in app settings
No devices found. Time to wake up your espresso machine.
Keep the espresso machine attended while the app controls it. Stop brewing immediately if the machine behaves unexpectedly.
Enter the serial printed on your machine, confirm the model, then search over Bluetooth.
If the label shows a separate BLE/MAC address, enter it to find that exact device. A serial number cannot be converted to a Bluetooth address.
Some machines do not broadcast their serial. Check the Bluetooth address and model before continuing. No device is selected automatically.
No matching machine found. Turn on Bluetooth and the machine, stay nearby, and disconnect other control apps before retrying.
Keep the machine powered on and nearby. The search runs for up to 20 seconds.
Different model. Change the selected model to continue.
Enter the serial number printed on the machine.
Use up to 64 letters, numbers, spaces or - _ / .
Enter a 12-digit hexadecimal Bluetooth address, such as AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF.
Bluetooth search could not start. Check Bluetooth and permissions, then retry.
The serial in the device name is the label you entered. It has not been verified by the machine. Confirm the Bluetooth address before connecting.
